protocol.standardization: original full-83 mean and population std retained; no fold rescaling
protocol.intercept: unpenalized; center z on each training fold for closed form
protocol.score: mean of 10 out-of-fold Pearson r values
protocol.rank: descending Pearson mean, competition rank (min); percentile uses strict <
protocol.generic: kernel-only centered eigensolve; discard roundoff null modes at 64*eps*n*max(input kernel Frobenius norm, centered spectral radius)
protocol.generic_scope: all 50 folds of DOG1, original bestblock, and corrected bestblock
protocol.interpretation: Numerical-only repair, not a new model-selection or preprocessing protocol.

root_cause.description: Full-sample zero mean does not imply fold-training zero mean; ytr.mean is not the raw-feature intercept unless ztr.mean*beta=0.

original_function_reproduction.method: isolated original function AST, all 8589 columns

archived_report.protocol: each block as its own rank-1 kernel, 10 repeats x 5-fold CV, lambda=1e-8

precision_note: Only measured absolute errors are reported. No unmeasured machine-precision equivalence is asserted.
